entities.summary: Johann Joseph Graf von Trautson zu Falkenstein was a Roman Catholic clergyman. In 1750 he was coadjutor of the Archdiocese of Vienna and Titular Archbishop of Cartagine, was appointed from 1751 to 1757 the Prince-Archbishop of Vienna, and was from 1756 to 1757 a cardinal.
